name: Whiteboard
look: A marker hand draws black lines on a white board, then fills the cup with colour.

name: Chalkboard
look: Dusty coloured chalk on a green-black board in a wooden frame.

name: Notepad doodle
look: Blue and red ballpoint doodles on lined, spiral-bound notebook paper.

name: Blueprint
look: White technical drawing on blueprint blue, with grid, dimensions and a title block.

name: Hand-drawn pencil sketch
look: Wobbly graphite lines and soft shading on warm paper, drawn on twos.

name: Urban sketch
look: Loose ink lines with watercolour washes and a street in the background.

name: Crayon book
look: Waxy crayon strokes like a child's colouring book, with a sun and crayons.

name: Watercolour
look: Soft wet-edged washes and blooms on textured paper.

name: One line
look: A single unbroken white line draws everything on a bold flat colour.

name: Cel line boil
look: Classic frame-by-frame cel look: ink outlines that jitter (boil) every few frames.

name: Flat vector
look: Clean 2D flat shapes, bright colours and no outlines, like an explainer app.

name: 80s cel anime
look: Hard cel shading, a sunset sky and a city skyline, like an 80s anime still.

name: Stick figure
look: A white round-head stick figure pours the chai under one hanging lamp.

name: Cut-out collage
look: Paper shapes with torn edges and drop shadows, moved like a cut-out puppet.

name: Red papercut
look: Red cut paper with lacy patterns and flowers on a warm background.

name: Paper pop-up
look: A pop-up book page: layered card that stands up with folds and shadows.

name: Shadow puppet
look: Black puppets with cut-out holes on rods, lit from behind on a glowing screen.

name: Woodcut
look: Black and white relief print with gouged lines and rough edges.

name: Engraving
look: Fine hatched lines like an old banknote, in a green ornamental frame.

name: Silkscreen poster
look: Flat ink layers, sunburst rays and slight misregistration, like a screen-printed poster.

name: Ukiyo-e
look: Flat colour and ink outlines like a Japanese woodblock print, with clouds and blossom.

name: Art deco
look: Gold lines, stepped frames and sunrays on deep teal, like a 1920s poster.

name: Stained glass
look: Coloured glass panes and black lead lines in an arched window.

name: Memphis diorama
look: 80s Memphis design: loud patterns, squiggles and a checkered floor in a little room.

name: Sticker explainer
look: Die-cut stickers with white borders that pop in, with bold word stickers.

name: Math diagram
look: A chalk-on-navy maths explainer: angles, points, a dotted pour path and a fill graph.
text: maths labels: θ = 38°, A, B, r, h(t), A sin(ωz)

name: Low-poly island
look: Faceted low-poly 3D: the cup sits on a tiny island with palm trees in a polygon sea.

name: Brick toy
look: Everything built from toy bricks and studs on a green baseplate.

name: Glass product
look: A clear glass kettle and cup lit like a product shot, with refraction and glow.

name: Claymation
look: Lumpy plasticine shapes with fingerprints, stepped like stop-motion.

name: Lidar survey
look: A glowing 3D point cloud, like a laser scan, in blue and gold.

name: Silent film
look: Black and white 1920s film: grain, flicker, scratches and a stage curtain.
text: intertitles: A CUP OF CHAI / Piping hot!

name: Newsreel
look: Sepia 1940s newsreel with a slanted headline banner and film damage.
text: headlines: THE POUR BEGINS / CUP FILLS FAST / STEAM RISES, and a CHAI! title card

name: Pixel art RPG
look: Chunky pixel sprites and stepped motion in a cosy room, with a game dialogue box.
text: dialogue box: THE KETTLE ARRIVES! / IT POURS HOT CHAI... / THE KULHAD IS FULL!

name: Microscope
look: The chai seen through a microscope: a round lens view of bubbles and specks.

name: Hologram HUD
look: A cyan sci-fi hologram with wireframes, readouts and a fill gauge.
text: HUD labels: TILT, POUR, FILL, STEAM, CUP LEVEL, HOT and a % readout

name: Circuit board
look: A green circuit board where the chai flows along glowing copper traces.
text: board labels: CHAI, KETTLE, POUR, KULHAD, FILL

name: Liquid motion
look: Smooth, bouncy, glossy shapes that stretch and settle like liquid.

name: Generative abstract
look: Thousands of tiny strokes in a flow field that form the kettle, pour and cup.
